observations.evidence_class: native-agent visual judgment over exact digital projection and render evidence
limitations: No human play, finite-emitter, normal-room, or physical-use observation was performed.
observations.summary: Rabbit and fox are legible, but the indexed owl is not an unmistakable creature and setup/reset cues are not self-evident.

checks.evaluator: Codex native mechanical reviewer plus deterministic fit and motion replay

observations.evidence_class: deterministic digital geometry replay plus independent source audit
limitations: No physical snap, detent, retention, tipping, pinch, strength, or cycle test was performed.
observations.summary: Declared reel and stand sweeps pass, but reset differentiation is geometrically ineffective and sharp oversized shell barbs lack a demonstrated closure path.

checks.evaluator: Codex native printability reviewer plus deterministic sealed-STL replay

observations.evidence_class: deterministic digital mesh, bed-fit, and wall-thickness evidence
limitations: No slicer or physical print, fit, material, warping, or support test was performed.
observations.summary: All four STL meshes are sound and bed-fitting, but the exact rear shell reproducibly fails the 0.8 mm fine wall gate in isolated rim regions.

feedback.area: indexed shadow recognition and setup cues
feedback.change: Preserve the three-profile reel concept, but revise the owl's broad external profile so ear tufts and wing/body separation survive exact clipping. Regenerate indexed and full-cycle evidence, add all four distance-band corners plus bounded yaw/pitch tests, and make reset and beam-direction cues legible in setup views.
feedback.finding: The exact 240-degree indexed owl collapses into a near-featureless oval/pawn mass; its ears, wings, and perch do not survive portal clipping as unmistakable owl cues. The current evidence also covers only one nominal distance pair.

feedback.area: detent reset, shell assembly, and containment
feedback.change: Model an asymmetric visible home feature, detent clearance and differential spring travel; add broad printable barb/receiver lead-ins; extend fit and motion evidence to detent engagement, shell insertion/retention, and stand endpoint stops before repeating physical checks.
feedback.finding: The rim is exactly 30-degree periodic and the nose fully relaxes in every pocket, so rabbit cannot have a unique deeper click; the sharp 4.2 x 6.0 mm barbs also lack a cam path through 3.6 x 5.4 mm slots.

feedback.change: Repair the rim with a finite at-least-0.8 mm land or broad printable fillet/chamfer, regenerate STEP/STL, and require standard and explicit fine wall-thickness reports to pass before Playtest repeats.
feedback.finding: The exact sealed rear-shell STL reproducibly fails the 0.8 mm fine wall gate at isolated outer-rim regions, with an independent replay minimum of 0.13 mm.
